findings.evidence: Copy says 'Drag the wheel to look around.' dom-1440.json shows the wheel cards as links but no previous/next buttons or other single-pointer control for rotating the ring.
findings.after: Add <button aria-label="Previous build"> and <button aria-label="Next build"> beside the wheel, and rotate on Left/Right arrow keys when a card has focus
findings.why: WCAG 2.2 2.5.7 Dragging Movements: dragging needs a single-pointer alternative. Not verified live.

findings.where: comparison tabs 'Farm records / Bank reconciliation / Webhook API'
findings.evidence: dom-1440.json: three <button role="tab">; no role="tablist" container or aria-selected/aria-controls recorded in the capture, and all three are separate Tab stops in focus.json (stop 14 is only 'Farm records'; the other two do not appear, suggesting roving tabindex). Visual selected state is fill colour only (black pill vs plain text).
findings.after: <div role="tablist" aria-label="Example prompt"><button role="tab" aria-selected="true" aria-controls="cmp-panel">… with Left/Right arrow keys moving between tabs
findings.why: WCAG 2.2 4.1.2 Name, Role, Value and 2.1.1 Keyboard: the tab pattern needs its selected state exposed and arrow-key access. Not verified live.

findings.evidence: focus.json: the fanned theme cards take focus in DOM order Atelier (y 646), Furrow (524), Cobalt (488), Studio, Ribbon, Dose, Coral, Bloom, then Furrow again; 'Furrow' appears twice (stops 5 and 12) linking to the same themes/furrow/.
findings.before: Nine focus stops, one duplicate, in a fan whose order is randomised by 'Deal again'
findings.after: Remove the duplicate card from the tab order (tabindex="-1" and aria-hidden on the repeat) and keep DOM order equal to left-to-right visual order after each deal
findings.why: WCAG 2.2 2.4.3 Focus Order: focus should follow a meaningful sequence without repeated stops.

findings.evidence: The h1 is built from per-word spans plus 'ghost' spans ('A', 'The') with an slash svg animating a word swap; the sweep flags overshoot easing cubic-bezier(0.3, 1.35, 0.5, 1). Ghost spans are aria-hidden, so the read name is fine, but the swap animation is not shown with a reduced-motion alternative in the evidence.
findings.before: Animated word swap in the h1
findings.why: WCAG 2.2 2.3.3 Animation from Interactions (AAA) / 2.2.2 if it loops. Not verified whether it loops.

strengths: Skip link 'Skip to the page' is first; header, nav, main and footer landmarks present.
Good accessible names on icon controls: 'Copy the install command', 'Hallmark on GitHub, 50,986 stars', 'Hallmark, back to the top'.
Comparison divider is a role="slider" with a name ('Divider between the two pages'), so it is reachable by keyboard.
Focus ring is a clear orange outline (focus/31-on.png).
not_investigated: Content in tiles 1440-03..07 did not paint in the capture (scroll-reveal); its visual contrast and reflow were not checked.
Image alt text: dom capture does not record alt values; sweep img_alt reported no misses.
Live keyboard checks of tabs, slider and wheel (no Playwright run).
